description: Create Django backend project with listings API. The backend provides REST endpoints for listings that include location data (latitude/longitude), photos, price, title, and distance calculation from user position. Structure: backend/ directory with Django project 'ejoutia' and app 'listings'.
steps: Create backend/manage.py as Django entry point

Create backend/ejoutia/__init__.py, backend/ejoutia/settings.py, backend/ejoutia/urls.py, backend/ejoutia/wsgi.py, backend/ejoutia/asgi.py with standard Django project configuration. Include rest_framework and corsheaders in INSTALLED_APPS.

Create backend/listings/models.py with Listing model containing fields: title (CharField), description (TextField), price (DecimalField), currency (CharField default 'DH'), latitude (FloatField), longitude (FloatField), photo (ImageField/URLField), created_at (DateTimeField), category (CharField)
Create backend/listings/serializers.py with ListingSerializer that includes all fields plus a computed 'distance' field (calculated from user_lat/user_lon query params using Haversine formula)

Create backend/listings/views.py with ListingViewSet that supports list/retrieve, accepts user_lat and user_lon query parameters, and annotates each listing with distance from user. Also add a filter for max_distance.
Create backend/listings/urls.py with router registration for ListingViewSet
Create backend/requirements.txt listing Django, djangorestframework, django-cors-headers, Pillow
acceptance_criteria: backend/manage.py exists and is valid Python
backend/ejoutia/settings.py configures REST framework and CORS
backend/listings/models.py defines Listing model with title, price, latitude, longitude, photo fields
backend/listings/serializers.py includes distance calculation using Haversine formula
backend/listings/views.py accepts user_lat/user_lon query params and returns listings with distance
backend/listings/urls.py registers the viewset with a DRF router
All Python files pass syntax validation with ast.parse()
verification: Run: find /projects/sandbox/E-joutia/backend -name '*.py' -exec python3 -c "import ast, sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read()); print(f'{sys.argv[1]}: OK')" {} \;
Confirm all expected files exist: manage.py, settings.py, models.py, serializers.py, views.py, urls.py
